## Description

Please include a summary of the change, motivation, and which issue is fixed.

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of Change

- [ ] `feat`: New feature or capability
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation or ADR update
- [ ] `refactor`: Internal structure change
- [ ] `test`: New or updated tests
- [ ] `ci` / `chore`: CI workflow or build configuration change

## Pre-Submission Verification Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the code style and formatting standards (`cargo fmt --check`).
- [ ] Static analysis passes with zero warnings (`cargo clippy -- -D warnings`).
- [ ] All existing and new unit/integration tests pass (`cargo test`).
- [ ] Documentation and ADRs have been updated if architectural invariants shifted.
- [ ] No temporary files, assistant plumbing, or secrets are included in this PR.
- [ ] All commits follow the `COMMIT-PROTOCOL.md` conventional commits convention.
